text.en:
The title to and ownership of that certain parcel of land wherein the court and stadium for
Basque pelota operated by the Jai-Alai and Amusement Corporation of the Philippines, situated in the City of
Manila is hereby transferred and vested in the National Development Company. Said parcel of land is more
particularly described as follows:
A parcel of land (lot 1-B-2, of the subdivision plan (LRC) Psd-36349, being a portion of Lot 1-B described on
plan (LRC) Psd-11613, LRC Cad. Rec. No. 392), situated in the District of Ermita, City of Manila, Island of
Luzon. Bounded on the NE, points 3 to 4 by Lot 2, Psc-929; on the SE., points 4 to 5 by Lot 2, Pcs-929; and
points 5 to 6 to 1 by Lot 4-B, Psd-5174; on the SW., points 1 to 2 by Taft Avenue; and on the NW., points 2 to
3 by Lot 1-B-1, of subdivision plan. Beginning at a point marked "1" on plan, being N. 27 deg. 58'W., 200.28
m. from BLLM. 47, Manila Cad. 13, thence N. 28 deg. 44'W., 89.69 m. to point 2; thence N. 61 deg. 12'E.,
72.44 m. to point 3; thence S.28 deg. 44'E.,88.78 m. to point 4; thence S. 59 deg. 54'W., 3.33 m. to point 5;
thence S. 60 deg. 24"'., 65.45 to point 6; thence S.62 deg. 24'W., 3.69 m. to the point of beginning; containing
an area of SIX THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY SQUARE METERS AND THIRTY
SQUARE DECIMETERS (6470.30) more or less. All points referred to are indicated on the plan and are
marked by the ground as follows: Point 6 by Old G.I.S. ON WALL, Point 6 by Old GIS. On Conc. Gatter;
Point 4 by OLD GIS. On Asphalt Road; Point 1 by Old GIS. Marked on the group and the rest by P.S. Cyl.
Conc. Mons. 15x60 cm.; bearings true; declination variable; date of original survey, Aug. 25, 1919 and that of
the subdivision survey, June 8, 1964."

The parcel of land herein conveyed shall be registered by the proper Register of Deeds and shall
issue the corresponding certificate of title to the National Development Company.

Any provision of law, proclamation, ordinance, rules or regulations to the contrary
notwithstanding, the National Development Company is hereby authorized to transfer ownership and convey
the said parcel of land to any person or corporation qualified to acquire lands under the Constitution and
holding a franchise to operate and maintain a fronton for Basque pelota games, either through public bidding
or through negotiations, as the interest of the government warrants.

The transfer, sale or disposition of said land shall be subject to the condition that after the
expiration of the franchise, the land and all improvements including facilities thereon shall revert to the
Government of the Philippines without payment.

All laws, executive orders, proclamations, rules and regulations or part thereof inconsistent with
this Decree are hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
